prompt: Original creature species design, storybook painterly illustration, warm night workshop lit by one amber work-light. THE SPECIES (identical anatomy in every case): cat-sized, standing upright on two plantigrade legs, feline GRACE and poise in how it sits and watches, soft dense fur, small dexterous hands with long careful fingers. Its ears are shaped like CURLED FERN FIDDLEHEADS that unfurl with age. Large dark liquid eyes with no visible whites and no slit pupils. A small soft muzzle-less face. A faint warm ember glow at the centre of its chest. A short plume tail. IT IS NOT A CAT — absolutely NO whiskers, NO whisker pads, NO triangular pointed cat ears, NO long tapering cat tail, NO pink cat nose. Not a Pokemon, not a Palworld Pal, not any existing character. Beside it, a single sleeved trading card nearly as TALL AS THE CREATURE, steadied carefully with both hands — precious and heavy. MUTED PALETTE: charcoal, moss green, weathered timber, deep indigo; only saturated colour is amber lamplight. No text, no lettering, no logos. THIS INDIVIDUAL: young, newly settled — ears still TIGHTLY CURLED like a fiddlehead just emerging, pale silver-grey fur, no lichen yet, a clean indigo apron a little too big, ember at the chest still faint. Eager, careful, slightly unsure.
policy: internal concept art only — never the shipped public face
